snippet.title: Hoptale trailer
snippet.description:
Solo-developed indie game from Taiwan — “Hoptale”
The free demo will debut on Oct 13th during Steam Next Fest!

Hoptale is a Roguelite with a unique core: “Hopscotch × Slot Machine.”
🔹 Explore, gather, fish, and solve puzzles through hopscotch.
🔹 In battle, the tiles transform into a slot machine — only by locking onto the safe path can you defeat monsters.
🔹 Even loot and rewards are decided by the slot machine — your fate lies in your reflexes!

(Still rushing to finish it, QuQ...)
